# Krydo

> Privacy-preserving financial trust on Stellar (Soroban).

Krydo lets issuers anchor verifiable credential hashes on Stellar and lets holders prove predicates with zero-knowledge proofs — without revealing raw claim values (salary, score, etc.).

## Product
- Website: https://www.krydo.in
- Android download: https://www.krydo.in/download
- Public verifier: https://www.krydo.in/verify
- Network: Stellar Testnet (Soroban)
- Auth: Sign-In with Stellar (SIWS / SEP-53)
- Contracts: KrydoAuthority, KrydoCredentials, KrydoAudit

## Code
- Primary: https://github.com/nishant-uxs/krydo-next
- SIH / demo lineage: https://github.com/nishant-uxs/krydo-stellar
